resumeText:
MOHAMMED AL-SHEHRI
Store Supervisor | Dammam, Saudi Arabia
m.alshehri@email.com | 05x-xxx-xxxx

SUMMARY
Retail supervisor with 4 years of experience running daily operations for a high-traffic electronics store, leading a team of 12 sales associates.

EXPERIENCE

Store Supervisor — eXtra Electronics, Dammam | Jan 2022 – Present
- Supervise a team of 12 sales associates across two shifts; store ranked top 5 of 40 branches for customer satisfaction in 2024.
- Manage inventory counts and shrinkage control; reduced stock discrepancies by 18% year over year.
- Prepare weekly sales summaries in Excel for the regional manager.
- Handle escalated customer complaints and returns at the service desk.

Sales Associate — eXtra Electronics, Dammam | Mar 2020 – Dec 2021
- Consistently exceeded monthly sales targets by 10-25% in the mobile and accessories section.
- Trained 6 new associates on the POS system and store procedures.

EDUCATION
High school diploma — Dammam Secondary School, 2019

SKILLS
Team leadership, customer service, inventory management, POS systems, Microsoft Excel (basic), scheduling, Arabic (native), English (conversational)
jobDescription:
Backend Software Engineer

Requirements:
- 3+ years of professional backend development experience
- Strong Python and Django (or FastAPI) in production
- PostgreSQL: schema design, indexing, query optimization
- Docker and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI or GitHub Actions)
- Designing and documenting REST APIs
- B.Sc. in computer science or equivalent practical experience

You will build and operate the order-management services behind our logistics platform.
